record.paper_title: Nicholson's blowflies differential equations revisited: Main results and open problems
record.context_brief: Global stability for nonautonomous Nicholson models
record.original_question: Let P and d be positive constants, let s be a maturation delay, and let the autonomous Nicholson blowflies equation be dN/dt = P N(t-s) exp(-N(t-s)) - d N(t), whose positive equilibrium is N* = ln(P/d) when P > d. Consider the following nonautonomous generalizations: a distributed-delay model dN/dt = -d N(t) + P integral from h(t) to t of N(u) exp(-N(u)) d_u R(t,u); a multiple-delay model N'(t) = -d N(t) + P sum from k=1 to m of a_k(t) N(h_k(t)) exp(-N(h_k(t))); and an integro-differential model N'(t) = -d N(t) + P integral from h(t) to t of K(t,u) N(u) exp(-N(u)) du. Establish global stability criteria for the positive equilibrium of these nonautonomous models that match the strength of the best known autonomous criteria, decide whether those autonomous criteria remain valid for variable delays bounded by t-s <= h(t) <= t, and find necessary delay-dependent conditions for global stability of both the autonomous and nonautonomous models.

evidence.quote: The main purpose of this section is to study some generalizations of Nicholson's Eq. (4) in variable environments.
Obtain global stability results for nonautonomous Eqs. (21)-(23) which are similar to the best known results in the autonomous case.
Find necessary delay-dependent conditions for global stability of Eqs. (4), (21)-(23).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the autonomous Nicholson blowflies delay differential equation
  N'(t) = P N(t-s) exp(-N(t-s)) - d N(t),
where P, d > 0 are constants with P > d and s > 0 is a constant maturation delay; this equation has the unique positive equilibrium N* = ln(P/d).

Consider the following three nonautonomous generalizations on t ≥ 0, in which h(t) is a measurable delay function satisfying t - s ≤ h(t) ≤ t for some s > 0, R(t,·) is, for each t, a nondecreasing function of bounded variation with R(t,t) - R(t,h(t)) = 1, the coefficients a_k(t) ≥ 0 satisfy Σ_{k=1}^m a_k(t) ≡ 1, the delays h_k(t) satisfy t - s ≤ h_k(t) ≤ t, and K(t,u) ≥ 0 with ∫_{h(t)}^{t} K(t,u) du = 1:

 (A) Distributed-delay model:
     N'(t) = -d N(t) + P ∫_{h(t)}^{t} N(u) exp(-N(u)) d_u R(t,u).

 (B) Multiple-delay model:
     N'(t) = -d N(t) + P Σ_{k=1}^m a_k(t) N(h_k(t)) exp(-N(h_k(t))).

 (C) Integro-differential model:
     N'(t) = -d N(t) + P ∫_{h(t)}^{t} K(t,u) N(u) exp(-N(u)) du.

Each of (A), (B), (C) admits N* = ln(P/d) as a positive equilibrium when P > d.

Solve the following:
 (i) Establish sufficient global stability criteria for the positive equilibrium N* of each of (A), (B), (C) whose strength matches the best known sufficient criteria available for the autonomous equation.
 (ii) Determine whether the best known sufficient global stability criteria for the autonomous equation remain valid when the constant delay s is replaced by an arbitrary variable delay h(t) with t - s ≤ h(t) ≤ t.
 (iii) Find necessary delay-dependent conditions for global stability of the positive equilibrium for both the autonomous equation and for each of the nonautonomous models (A), (B), (C).
artifact.category_tag: delay differential equations / Nicholson blowflies global stability
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on nonautonomous Nicholson blowflies models reports progress only on delay-independent global stability criteria (via fluctuation lemma and differential inequalities), while sharp delay-dependent and necessary conditions matching the strongest known autonomous results remain unresolved. Several 2019–2024 works treat related multi-delay or density-dependent mortality variants but explicitly leave delay-dependent necessary global stability conditions for the nonautonomous distributed/multi-delay/integro-differential Nicholson models open.

status_evidence.title: Global asymptotic stability for a nonlinear density-dependent mortality Nicholson's blowflies system involving multiple pairs of time-varying delays
status_evidence.snippet: Differential inequality techniques and the fluctuation lemma are used to establish delay-independent criteria on the global asymptotic stability of the addressed model.
status_evidence.claim: State-of-the-art results for nonautonomous Nicholson systems are delay-independent, indicating delay-dependent criteria remain open.

status_evidence.title: Global asymptotic behaviour of positive solutions to a non-autonomous Nicholson's blowflies model with delays
status_evidence.snippet: Studies global behavior of nonautonomous Nicholson's blowflies model with time-varying delays, providing sufficient but not necessary conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Existing nonautonomous results are sufficient-only, not matching necessary delay-dependent conditions.

status_evidence.title: Nicholson's blowflies differential equations revisited: Main results and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems on global stability for nonautonomous Nicholson equations.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an open problem in the survey.
